description: Update rank-change alert settings for one RankParse website: enable/disable the weekly digest (opt-in, default off), set the moved_up/moved_down position threshold (1-50, default 5), or set/clear an email override for that site's digest lines (null reverts to the account email). Only the fields you pass change. Confirm with the user before enabling -- this turns on a real weekly email when meaningful changes exist.

email_override.description: Email address to send this site's digest lines to instead of the account email; null clears it

enabled.description: Turn the weekly alert digest on or off for this site

move_threshold.description: Average-position delta that counts as moved_up/moved_down (default 5)

site_id.description: Logical RankParse website ID, from list_rank_tracking_sites

name: update_rank_alert_settings
